title: Russia Strikes Kyiv and Odesa for Seventh Consecutive Night, Injuring at Least 27
detail: Russia launched drones and ballistic missiles at Kyiv and Odesa overnight into September 3, the seventh consecutive night of sustained bombardment of the capital. In Kyiv, an attack injured 10 people, including six medical personnel, sparked a fire, and badly damaged a high-rise residential building, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. In Odesa, a Russian strike hit a 21-story residential building, injuring 17 people including three children and damaging 20 apartments on floors 10 through 17 along with 12 parked cars, according to Ukraine's National Police. Western Ternopil Oblast was also targeted. Russian jet-powered and standard attack drones were used alongside ballistic missiles in the barrage.

title: Putin Says Ukraine Peace Deal Possible, Cites US and China Support, but Flags Obstacles
detail: Speaking at the Eastern Economic Forum in Russia's Far East on September 3, President Vladimir Putin said there was a chance of reaching an agreement to end the war in Ukraine, adding that the United States, China, and other countries were ready to support a settlement. 'We are grateful to everyone attempting to contribute to a settlement. Is there a chance? In my view, yes, there is,' Putin said. He simultaneously argued that renewed Ukrainian strikes on shipping and Kyiv's call for civilian aircraft to avoid Russian airspace made restarting talks harder. Neither Putin nor Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, who also spoke publicly the same day, cited concrete reasons to expect near-term progress.

media.caption: Putin speaks at the Eastern Economic Forum, citing a chance for a peace settlement, September 3, 2026
